en.title: Data protection
en.summary: The clinic's obligations under the Personal Data Protection Proclamation (No. 1321/2024): how long records are kept, the breach log, and where patients' rights are answered.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Set how many years after a patient was last seen their record is kept. The list shows the records past that period, oldest first. Nothing is deleted automatically — review each and decide; a child's record, or one in a dispute, is kept.

sections.heading: A patient's rights
sections.body: A copy of their record: on the chart, The patient's copy of their record — printed or as a file, logged when given. Who has seen it: the chart's Access log. A correction: change it on the chart; every change is in the audit trail.

am.title: የግል መረጃ ጥበቃ
am.summary: በግል መረጃ ጥበቃ አዋጅ (ቁጥር 1321/2016) የክሊኒኩ ግዴታዎች፦ መዝገቦች ለምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚቀመጡ፣ የጥሰት መዝገብ፣ እና የታካሚዎች መብቶች።

sections.heading: የማቆያ ጊዜ
sections.body: አንድ ታካሚ ለመጨረሻ ጊዜ ከታየ በኋላ መዝገቡ ለስንት ዓመት እንደሚቀመጥ ያስቀምጡ። ዝርዝሩ ጊዜው ያለፈባቸውን መዝገቦች ያሳያል። ምንም በራስ-ሰር አይሰረዝም።

sections.heading: የታካሚ መብቶች
sections.body: የመዝገቡ ቅጂ፦ በቻርቱ ላይ "ለታካሚው የሚሰጥ የመዝገቡ ቅጂ"። ማን እንዳየው፦ የቻርቱ የመዳረሻ መዝገብ። እርማት፦ በቻርቱ ላይ ይቀይሩ፤ እያንዳንዱ ለውጥ ይመዘገባል።
